name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)

eligibility.income_limit: Must not be an income taxpayer. Targeted at unorganized sector workers.

benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs. 1000 to Rs. 5000 per month starting from age 60, depending on contribution amount. Same pension continues to spouse on subscriber's demise.
application_process: Approach bank branch or post office where you hold a savings account.
Fill out APY registration form with auto-debit consent.
Ensure monthly debit balance is maintained.
